comments.text: There are a ton of places near 2nd Street—definitely check out [2ND & PCH](https://2ndandpch.com/dine/) and all of the restaurants on 2nd Street. Really depends on what you're looking for, but they have a variety of food from American, Mexican, Japanese, Chinese, and etc. There are also restaurants near the Traffic Circle as well.

comments.text:
If you walk by Target, which is maybe 10 minutes. There's a place called Blue Burro, which from what I remember has some really good asada fries, they do have other stuff but the portion size for the large asada fries could be enough for the whole day. 
There is also an acai place but the coffee spot in the USU, is more convenient and the acai bowls there are really good. If you want cheaper options I would suggest El Pollo Loco or Subway, \*look through the apps, they have good deals and you don't gotta wait in long lines. If you are feeling kinda lazy, you can also Uber Eats. I know there are always deals like 50% off a $25 order or something. Makes it so you can get whatever you want outside of campus without worrying about parking or walking.
comments.author: ReporterFrequent9899

comments.text: East Coast Bagels has really good bagels and the best cream cheese! Def my go-to for breakfast or brunch. Pizzamania is also super great (their cheesy garlic bread is so good) and if you show your student ID card you get 10% off.
